not_added_scope: Deferred records include unreviewed reserves; not all 83 records are substantively rejected. They are not counted as additions.

local_validation.cross_branch_sources: Identical catalog and skill source data; each branch regenerates its own language interface.

publication_method: Reviewed collection PR merged to main after successful CI, then zh synchronized and pushed using an atomic Git ref update; no force pushes or branch deletion.
scope_limitations: Repository metadata and provenance only; no candidate clone, installation, execution or third-party skill-body import.

Independent checks cover source identity and fixed-tree README/representative/license bytes. Public file counts preserve per-package semantics, not global skill originality or runtime/security/scientific certification.
Receipt records already published dataset commits and observed successful CI. Receipt-only commits add no repositories.
